# [3.7.0-dev.8](https://github.com/anddea/revanced-patches/compare/v3.7.0-dev.7...v3.7.0-dev.8) (2025-04-20)

> [!NOTE]  
> Yandex [SOTA](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/State_of_the_art) video transcription is faster and more reliable than Gemini's output from basic instructions¹. However, it is primarily available only for English and Russian, as supported by Yandex, other languages return error responses; there is no proxy code for countries where API calls to Yandex may be blocked²³. Inspired by [VOT](https://github.com/ilyhalight/voice-over-translation) (they have proxy server).
>
> ¹ For prompt engineers: Feel free to test and let us know the best prompt(s) & model(s) for Gemini.
> ² For developers: You're welcome to examine and improve the workflow/code/layout, as I don't plan to make further changes.
> ³ Yandex's limited output in English and Russian can be extended by sending a new prompt to Gemini for translation. Feel free to add the correctly working prompt to the code, or let us know if this effort is needed at all. The proxy server can be easily added if needed by anyone. 
>
> New contributors are always welcome. After all, we’re not eternal, someone will need to take our place someday.
>
